United States.title: US House Committee Holds Impeachment Inquiry Hearing
United States.summary: The US House committee held an impeachment inquiry hearing, with a Democratic witness accusing former US President Donald Trump's lawyer of witness tampering.

United States.title: US Justice Department Seeks To Unseal Additional Trump Documents
United States.summary: The US Justice Department filed a motion to unseal additional documents from the Trump Mar-a-Lago search, potentially revealing more classified information about the former President.

United States.title: Biden Administration To Release Plan To Counter Threats From China In Space
United States.summary: The Biden administration is set to release a plan to counter threats from China in space, amid growing concerns about the risks of a space war.

South Korea.title: Protests against government's education policy continue in Seoul, with students and teachers demanding reforms
South Korea.summary: Thousands of students and teachers continued to protest in Seoul, demanding reforms to the government's education policy, which they claim is unfair and stressful.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile into Sea of Japan, prompting condemnation from South Korea and US
South Korea.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan, prompting a strong condemnation from South Korea and the US.

South Korea.title: South Korea reports spike in COVID-19 cases, with authorities urging citizens to get vaccinated
South Korea.summary: South Korea reported a spike in COVID-19 cases, with authorities urging citizens to get vaccinated and take necessary precautions to prevent the spread of the virus.

Japan.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile over Japan, prompting evacuation orders
Japan.summary: Japan's government said it detected a 'possible imminent threat' after a ballistic missile was launched, and a 'danger zone' was set up in several locations. Residents in northern Japan were evacuated as the missile flew over the country's main island

Japan.title: Tens of Thousands of Pro-Democracy Protesters March in Tokyo
Japan.summary: Protesters gathered in multiple locations in Tokyo to protest against the Japanese government's plan to revise the constitution and other national security laws. They held various banners and chanted slogans in front of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government building and other locations
